reasons: Rule kind is 'missing' and the finding matches: rationale reports no occurrence of 'insurance' anywhere and Section 10 (General Provisions) runs from Notices to Headings/Counterparts without a coverage requirement, so insertion rather than amendment is the correct operation.

The inserted Section 10.9 tracks the model language and preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request) and is placed in the miscellaneous section per the redline guidance, leaving p0070 untouched — a minimal, self-contained addition.

Applicability is supported: HDI develops/hosts the Site and, per Section 8.1, accesses Company content, user information and data, so a vendor processing Customer Data with no insurance at all sits in walk-away territory.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, and offers the fallback (lower E&O/cyber limits) as a discussion point without lecturing.
Deterministic checks both pass; no over-flagging concern since there is no existing clause at preferred or fallback level to upgrade.
